responsibility: This implementation module adapts `ARRAY OF CHAR` pathnames to the string-oriented filesystem wrapper by converting each incoming path into a `DynamicStrings.String` with `InitString`, delegating the real work to `StringFileSysOp`, and then releasing the temporary string with `KillString`. It is the fixed-buffer filesystem bridge in the gm2 library stack, sitting above `StringFileSysOp` and ultimately `CFileSysOp` rather than performing OS calls itself.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the FileSysOp pair: unlike `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/FileSysOp.def`, it performs the `ARRAY OF CHAR` to `DynamicStrings.String` conversion and forwards each operation to `StringFileSysOp`.
